summary: Admins can view and edit every system email’s subject and Markdown body with safe placeholders, preview, test send, version history and revert; security alert templates need a recent sign-in.
detailed_changes: Added a registry of every system email (account, security, mailing consent, staff alerts and transport tests) with defaults in code and optional stored overrides (#645).
Stored templates use a sandboxed {{ tag }} renderer with allowlists, escaping, sanitised Markdown and an automatic plain-text part; Blade or PHP in a template is never executed (#646).

Notifications and mailables, including password reset and email verification, read subject and body through the registry so an override appears in sent mail while unchanged defaults match today (#647).
Admin → Settings → Email templates lists templates by group and opens an editor with a placeholder picker, required-tag checks and locked-parts notices (#648).
Admins can preview HTML and plain text (desktop or mobile width) and send a throttled test to themselves, with provider errors surfaced (#649).
Every save keeps a version with who and when; admins can diff, restore a version, or revert to the code default, all audit-logged (#650).
Staff cannot open the templates screens. Security alert templates can be changed only after the admin re-confirms sign-in within five minutes; all changes are audit-logged without secrets (#651).
affected_areas: User groups affected: admins (editors); staff (no access); account holders (receive the same emails unless an admin overrides wording)
Public impact: none unless an admin changes a template
Internal impact: editable system email wording with preview, test send, history and recent-auth for security templates
